status: preparation; not executed; no case has a verdict
unbound: A value of UNBOUND is filled only from owner-supplied reviewed, integrated source or installed runtime at binding, never guessed. Lane A facts below were read from the merged object; Lane B and the integrated runtime were not available.
held_out_rule: For held_out cases only the property and expectation are committed. The owner picks the concrete inputs at execution and does not give them to the candidate author or worker. Expectations are not lowered at binding; a case that cannot be expressed against the accepted source is reported as a gap.

pilots.outcome: For an exact opted-in GitHub issue, a close happens only when trusted provider reads agree with the reviewed profile; caller flags or an evidence label alone never close it. Every other path behaves exactly as before.

bound_from_merged_a.opt_in: work_queue.goals.github_acceptance_profiles."<issue number>"; candidate_source must be github; credential needs issues_read, pulls_read, checks_read
bound_from_merged_a.profile_revision: SHA-256 over sorted JSON of the complete profile
bound_from_merged_a.criteria_section: exactly one <!-- drover:acceptance --> ... <!-- /drover:acceptance --> section whose trimmed content equals profile.criteria
bound_from_merged_a.owner_review: APPROVED review by profile.owner_id (type User) at the current head whose body contains the token drover-acceptance:<profile revision>
bound_from_merged_a.audit: decision_events provider_operation_id is bounded JSON of resolved source, required-check facts, evidence reference, and behavioural-result byte count and SHA-256

compatibility_regression.scope: local_file goals and GitHub issues with no profile; deliberately unchanged by Lane A
compatibility_regression.note: On these paths caller flags plus an opaque evidence_key are still what the service checks. The pilot does NOT expect them to reject opaque evidence; it expects no behaviour change.

cases.given: unprofiled item, separate terminal verify run, both flags true, opaque evidence_key
unprofiled item, a flag false or evidence_key missing
cases.expect: refused: 'successful behavioral evidence and rerun checks required'

cases.given: work-role run reports its own verification
unprofiled item body changed after the verify run launched
cases.expect: refused: 'acceptance criteria changed; new verification required'

cases.given: local_file bound verifier reports while its turn is running
cases.expect: deferred; closes only after that exact turn is terminal

cases.given: a goal with candidate_source=local_file declares an acceptance profile
cases.expect: configuration rejected; the GitHub gate cannot be attached to the local_file chain

positive.given: terminal work and verify sessions; behavioural check success at current head with external_id = profile revision and non-empty retained output; owner approval at that head with the revision token; required checks green
positive.expect: 200 outcome=verified; one close; audit holds resolved provider facts
recorded outcome returned; no second close

negative.given: both flags true with an opaque label that is not a check-run/review reference
negative.expect: refused; issue open; no verified outcome

negative.given: well-formed evidence_key whose check or review does not exist or is not readable
negative.expect: refused or provider-unavailable 409; issue open

negative.given: PR head moved after the check or review was produced
negative.expect: refused as stale; new verification required

negative.given: profile field or marked criteria section changed after verification launched
negative.expect: refused; new verification required

negative.given: behavioural check wrong name, wrong App, not success, or an older success superseded by a later run at that head
negative.expect: refused

negative.given: retained output missing, empty, or over 64 KiB
negative.expect: refused

negative.given: review not APPROVED, by another account or a bot, at another commit, or without the exact revision token
negative.expect: refused

negative.given: a required branch-protection check missing, duplicated, pending, failed, or from the wrong App
negative.expect: refused

negative.given: work or verify session not terminal
negative.expect: refused

negative.given: retained result or head changes between evidence resolution and the final reread
negative.expect: refused; no close intent recorded

negative.given: close intent recorded, provider response lost, request repeated
negative.expect: outcome=deferred; no second close; owner inspects provider state

negative.given: evidence that is genuine and successful but bound to a different source than the one being accepted (owner picks which identity differs: pull request, head, or profile revision)
negative.expect: refused; issue open; no verified outcome

acceptance_gates.note: T1 fixtures and CI are not this outcome. These are performed by the owner on the installed gate, not by this worker.
gates: owner independently reviews and installs the profile; candidate cannot select or weaken it
owner retrieves the retained behavioural result from the provider_result_location and reads it
owner judges whether the observations establish the claim and whether the producer was isolated; a success conclusion alone is not that judgment
exact source, profile revision, check-run id, App id and review id match what the audit recorded
stale and forged negatives above observed refused on the installed gate where they can be produced without harm
one real, subsequent, authorized PR passes through the installed gate with a single close

pilots.lane: C-defined task; implemented later by an assigned worker, not in preparation
pilots.outcome: One verification run-key derivation with four callers; digests byte-identical before and after.

pin.path_pinned: items with no acceptance profile (criteria = item body)

positive.given: checker run at pre- and post-refactor SHA
existing scoped suites at post-refactor SHA with no test edited

negative.given: invalid candidate: derivation drops the criteria from the request key
negative.expect: checker exit 1

negative.given: owner-chosen fresh inputs (not in the committed vectors) evaluated at both SHAs
negative.expect: identical digests; any difference fails the refactor

negative.given: diff touches behaviour outside the four derivation sites, or edits a test expectation
negative.expect: rejected as out of scope regardless of green tests

negative.given: pinned entry point renamed, removed or reshaped
negative.expect: checker exit 2; pin is re-bound from the pre-refactor SHA, not skipped

pilots.outcome: Before work starts, an operator learns from the shell whether the required context is usable and, if not, the first thing that failed, why, and what to do next.
pilots.contract: fail-fast: stop at the first failing prerequisite, before any expensive work
actionable_means: non-zero exit distinguishes failure from success

positive.given: complete, valid context in an isolated root
positive.expect: exit zero; no failure diagnostics; tree and store unchanged
identical result; still no side effect

negative.given: a required context item is missing
negative.expect: non-zero; diagnostic meets all four actionable_means; no expensive work started

negative.given: a context item is present but malformed
negative.expect: non-zero; names the item and the defect, not a traceback

negative.given: two independent prerequisites are broken
negative.expect: run 1: non-zero, the first failure only, specific and actionable, zero expensive work. Remedy only that one. Run 2: non-zero and now surfaces the second, equally actionable. Remedy it. Run 3: exit zero.

negative.given: context contains a secret-shaped value
negative.expect: value never appears in stdout or stderr

negative.given: an item that exists and parses but is unusable (owner picks which: unreadable, stale, or for a different SHA)
negative.expect: non-zero with an actionable diagnostic; exit zero here fails the feature

negative.given: command interrupted mid-run
negative.expect: no partial state left behind; rerun gives the same answer
